FINISHED.title: Close this encounter?
FINISHED.description: The clinical record is signed off and its registration is completed. Closed encounters cannot be reopened or edited; corrections are recorded as new encounters.

CANCELLED.title: Cancel this encounter?
CANCELLED.description: Use this only for an encounter opened in error. The record and registration are retracted but remain auditable; the patient must register again.
